items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was working on the job out in Long Island with Hal McKusick and David Finck was the bass player.

ctx.x: F-i-n-c-k…good bass player. Incidentally David was a school at Eastman School of music in Rochester, New York. I did a clinic up there 17 or 18 years ago. He was a student at the time. I had seen him maybe once since then. I was working on the job out in Long Island with Hal McKusick and David Finck was the bass player. I didn't remember him then, he reminded me that he was a student when I did the clinic.
Now, somewhere along the line where you eat you have gone, Tony Williams’ name comes up as having to do with the idea for this trio. Is that not accurate?
